tools.name: advise
tools.description: Asks the provider's cruise advisor for a short, honest opinion on ONE offer from find_cruises: overall fit, or which cabin category or fare suits the travellers. Use it ONLY when the user asks about ONE specific offer ('is this right for me', 'which cabin', 'which fare') -- not after every find_crui

tools.name: booking_facts
tools.description: Returns the provider's own statement on booking: who the tour operator is, who acts as agent, how the customer's payment is protected (insolvency cover), how payment and cancellation work -- plus links to the legal pages. Use it when the user asks whether booking here is safe, who they are contracti

tools.name: cruise_line_profile
tools.description: Returns the consulting profile of a cruise line: who it suits, who it suits less, its style and fleet. Use it when the user asks which cruise line fits them or what a line is like. It does NOT return prices, offers or booking conditions.

tools.name: find_cruises
tools.description: Searches the live, bookable sea and river cruise offers of cruise · honeefy (booked through honeepot GmbH) for a destination, a travel period and a travel party. Prices and availability are read from the provider's booking system at the time of the call and change several times a day. It fits questi

tools.name: port_info
tools.description: Returns facts about a cruise port: country, port code, coordinates and how many routes call there. Use it when the user asks about a port of call or departure port. It does NOT provide excursions, sights, weather or transfer advice, and it knows only ports in the provider's catalogue.

tools.name: ship_profile
tools.description: Returns the profile of a cruise ship: cruise line, year built, size, passengers, crew and the consulting description. Use it when the user asks what a ship is like or wants to compare ships. It does NOT return deck plans, cabin numbers, live prices or availability.

tools.name: show_offers
tools.description: Shows the user the cruises you are recommending, as cards with ship photo, route, dates, price and booking link -- drawn by the host, not by you.
